title: Screen flow wizard: every step's button reads 「提交」 and every step toasts 「已保存 — 下一步」, so a user cannot tell which click submits
body:
Filing class: ① user-visible defect — reach: public door, measured in a browser on the 18.1.0 Console (`objectstack dev --ui`) with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main`, and the code read on objectstack `main` `1c632311`. **Reader:** the UI lane, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx`.

## Business reason
A multi-step screen flow is how an app builds a wizard. hotclm's 发起合同 wizard has five flat steps. Its last step asks 「立即提交」 — whether to send the contract to legal or keep it as a draft. Every earlier step's button already says 「提交」, so a requester reasonably believes the contract was submitted on step 1, and the last step's choice reads as noise.

## Measured
- Step 1 「合同信息」 (a flat screen, 12 fields), step 3 「首个版本」, step 5 「提交合同」: the footer is 取消 / **提交** on each. The label is fixed: `FlowRunner.tsx:740` renders `t('common.submit')` for every non-terminal flat screen, and the screen config has no key for it.
- After each step a success toast 「已保存 — 下一步」 appears (`FlowRunner.tsx:530`, `flowRunner.nextStep`), even after a step that saved nothing (step 1 only collects variables; the record is created two steps later).
- No step indicator: the dialog does not say 「第 2 步，共 5 步」, so the user does not know how far they are. The object-form wizard has `stepFallback` / `progressLabel` keys; the flat-screen path draws neither.

## Expected
- A non-final screen's primary button reads 下一步 (or a label the screen declares); only the last screen reads 提交 or the flow's own wording.
- No success toast between steps, or one only when a step actually wrote a record.
- A step counter when the run knows it has more screens.

Dedupe: objectstack issues (2,000 most recent, all states) and the archived objectui issues grepped for `nextStep`, `Saved — next`, `Save & Continue`, `step indicator`, `screen flow` + `submit` — objectui#12088 (Submit stays on screen for a long form) and #12234 / #12246 (terminal toast copy) are neighbours; none covers the per-step label or toast.

---
_Filed from the hotclm UI/UX review (2026-10-27); maintainer: 「平台的问题应该提交issue到平台」._
